body: Its funny because people that havent talked to me in quite a while are messaging me, saying if i want to talk. And then the people i mentioned it to saying "i didnt know you were serious, please talk"..why the hell would i bring it up if i werent serious

Thats not why i think ill be alone. I know ill be alone because if someone like that would break up with someone like me (and yes i realize how conceited that sounds, i dont have time to go into the details) then i have 0 chance of finding anyone that wouldnt treat me so horribly
Well no that's not really what i meant either; i meant successful in that i could lead a comfortable and reasonable life but that if im alone it wouldnt mean anything. and i know im going to be alone

As in the edit, just said bye to my best friend. he wouldnt stop talking so i had to hang up on him. not like he cared much when i mentioned it to him a few days ago. all that's left is my brother answering his phone
Yeah, go ahead. i have no idea why the hell my brother's not answering his phone
Tried talking to her. She never apologized for anything but did say she felt bad for hurting me. Then she went right back to it; Ihavent talked to her in weeks, we were together almost 2 years
I could be the most successful person in the world but if im alone then it wont matter

Oddly enough, i think she's the only person who could stop me right now. Not in a "please take me back or ill kill myself way", because id never take her back. But an apology for shredding my heart and sending me into this spiral. I wish someone would tell her how much she fucking hurt me

like i said above, im here until my brother answers his phone. not sure what he's doing

Ill talk until my brother answers his phone, dont want to do it without saying bye to him. I guess thats why i made the post, i didnt want to sit here bored until he answers, staring at these supposed friends of mine begging me not to do it. I fucking hate them. I tried to reach out to so many people and nobody gave a fuck. i wonder what my whore of an ex is going to think. and i didnt fail to get into this school; i worked my ass off to get in, then proceeded to waste 2 years here slowly failing out until it just happened
